question:
You are an accountant. Given a bank transaction record, please summarize income and expenses separately by Transaction Date and Counterparty Account Name. In the "Income/Expense Amount" column, positive values represent income and negative values represent expenses. Use Transaction Date as the row header (recognize dates only, ignore time), and Counterparty Account Name as the column header.
Income: Positive values in the "Income/Expense Amount" column are income; aggregate by Transaction Date and Counterparty Account Name. When generating the income report, remove the leading plus sign from numbers and fill in all dates completely.
Expenses: Negative values in the "Income/Expense Amount" column are expenses; aggregate by Transaction Date and Counterparty Account Name. When outputting the expense report, remove the negative sign from the numbers.
